name: seqplot.ts
title: Two series on one pair of axes. The check is the shared range of time and of the finite values.

origin.description: Two series on one pair of axes. The check is the shared range of time and of the finite values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Two series on one pair of axes. The check is the shared range of time and of the finite values.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
sx <- ts(c(1, 2, 4, 3), start = 1, frequency = 1)
sy <- ts(c(0, 2, 1, 5), start = 2, frequency = 1)
xlim <- range(time(sx), time(sy))
ylim <- range(sx, sy)
paste(cell(xlim[1]), cell(xlim[2]), cell(ylim[1]), cell(ylim[2]), sep = ",")
